fields.doc: Which world rule to run: the BFF program soup, or Conway's Game of Life.
fields.name: substrate

fields.doc: World width in cells; the world is a torus.
fields.name: width

fields.doc: World height in cells; the world is a torus.
fields.name: height

fields.doc: Bytes of tape held by one soup cell. Ignored by the life substrate.
fields.name: tape_len

fields.doc: The longest a soup cell's tape may grow to, through the programs' own copying: a head stepping right off the end of an interaction appends a byte instead of wrapping while there is room. 0 turns growth off, which is the fixed-length substrate of DESIGN 1.1, and so does any value equal to tape_len; below tape_len it is refused.
fields.name: max_tape_len

fields.doc: Moore-neighbourhood radius an interaction reaches; 0 means well-mixed. A positive radius must fit the torus: 2*radius + 1 <= min(width, height).
fields.name: radius

fields.doc: Instruction budget for one interaction between two tapes.
fields.name: max_steps

fields.doc: Instructions one cell may pay for per epoch, refilled at the start of every epoch; an interaction runs on what the poorer of its two cells has left. 0 turns the cost off, which is the substrate of DESIGN 1.1.
fields.name: energy_per_epoch

fields.doc: Instructions one cell is given per epoch, added to a stock that carries across epochs up to energy_stock_cap rather than being refilled to it. An interaction runs on what the poorer of its two cells holds, both are debited what ran, and a cell whose stock is empty is not executed until it has recharged. 0 turns the stock off, which is the substrate of DESIGN 1.1.
fields.name: energy_influx

fields.doc: The most instruction energy one cell's stock may hold, which is also the stock every cell starts the run with, so the world's total energy never exceeds cell count times this. Read only once energy_influx is set, and refused below it.
fields.name: energy_stock_cap

fields.doc: The BFF instructions this run executes, as a string of distinct op bytes. A byte whose op is left out is a no-op, like any non-instruction byte.
fields.name: ops

fields.doc: Probability a byte is replaced by a random byte, per byte per epoch. Applies to every substrate: the ordinary Game of Life needs 0.
fields.name: mutation_rate

fields.doc: How the world varies from place to place: uniform runs one mutation rate everywhere, which is the world of DESIGN 1.1; gradient runs a triangle across the columns, driest at column 0 and wettest half a world east; patchwork runs four quadrants alternating dry and wet.
fields.name: structure

fields.doc: How far a structured world's cells lean from mutation_rate, as a fraction of it: the driest cell runs at 1 - amplitude times the rate and the wettest at 1 + amplitude.
fields.name: structure_amplitude

fields.doc: What an interaction executes: concat runs the whole concatenation of the two tapes, which is the substrate of DESIGN 1.1; host runs the first tape's bytes only, leaving the partner as data the program reads and writes. Both heads range over the whole pair either way.
fields.name: interaction

fields.doc: Initial world state: uniformly random bytes, or all zero (the control).
fields.name: init

fields.doc: Record the observables every this many epochs.
fields.name: sample_every

fields.doc: How many of the most common tapes are put through the replicator test.
fields.name: top_k

fields.doc: Write a full world snapshot every this many epochs.
fields.name: snapshot_every
